items.title: The projective schemes over an ample base form a category closed under base change, composition, fibre products, sums, and contain the finite ones
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For S with an ample invertible sheaf, the full subcategory P_S of schemes satisfying the projective equivalent conditions (lemma-projective, collected as L16075) is stable under base change along maps of ample bases, composition, fibre products, finite disjoint unions, and contains all finite S-schemes; the author's statement list ends with the placeholder item add more here retained verbatim. The retained proof is written part by part: (1) Morphisms, lemma base-change-projective; (2) the fifth characterization of lemma-projective plus properness of compositions (Morphisms, lemma composition-proper); (3) from (1) and (2); (4) the one-line ample-on-pieces-implies-ample fact (details omitted by the author) plus the fifth characterization; (5) Morphisms, lemma finite-projective. Retained author proof at lines 14121-14148.
